title: Business Systems Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

Gamma Technologies (GT), the global leader in multi-physics system simulation software, develops a suite of integrated solutions designed to guide and accelerate the engineering transformation of today’s products. Fusing advanced physics with AI algorithms, our platform, GT-SUITE, is used to simulate a broad range of systems from early stage development to digital twin applications across multiple industries including transportation and mobility, marine, aerospace and defense, power and energy, data centers and HVACR.

At Gamma Technologies, our people are the driving force behind our success. We are looking for Business Systems Engineer who shares our passion for authentic innovation, trusted partnerships, bold decisions and a relentless focus on customer success.

**What You Will Do**

At Gamma Technologies, the right systems keep our technical and business teams moving. As GT grows and our needs become more complex, you will make sure the right solutions are delivered, maintained, and continuously improved.

In this role, you will:

* Administer and develop solutions within our business systems, including our CRM (Salesforce) and LMS (Docebo)
* Support our marketing automation (HubSpot), ERP (NetSuite), and other business platforms
* Work with our technical systems, including development task management (ClickUp) and revision control (Perforce and Git)
* Help evaluate and onboard new systems as our needs evolve
* Develop and maintain integrations between our systems, a critical part of this role
* Partner with business users to deliver, maintain, and continuously improve the solutions they rely on

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 4+ years of experience in the Information Technology/Systems field
* Hands-on Salesforce configuration experience: Flow, permission sets, custom objects and fields, reports and dashboards, SOQL, Data Loader, and deployment through sandboxes
* Hands-on LMS administration experience: content and course management, reports and dashboards, user and group management, workflow automation
* Experience administering at least one other business system end to end
* Experience building and maintaining integrations between business systems using APIs, webhooks, and/or middleware (Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Zapier, or custom code)
* Ability to work directly with non-technical business users and translate their needs into working solutions
* Working knowledge of compliance and information security practices as they apply to business systems: least-privilege access, segregation of duties, and supporting access reviews and audit evidence requests
* Ability and willingness to work from 3:00 PM to 11:59 PM IST to collaborate with global teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified LMS administrator
* Salesforce Certified Administrator (Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder a plus)
* Experience with Apex and Lightning Web Components
* Experience administering ERP, marketing, legal ticketing, and/or task management platforms
* Familiarity with revision control systems (e.g., Git, Perforce)
* Familiarity with SSO (SAML/OIDC) configuration for business applications

**What We Can Offer You**

* A dynamic and highly talented team of experts
* The opportunity to bring in your own ideas, implement them, and make them accessible to a large customer base
* A primary work location at our Pune, India office, with a hybrid work policy asking employees to report to the office 3 days per work week
* An attractive salary and additional company benefits

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer, dedicated to creating an inclusive workplace for all.

title: System Admin
description:
**Experience: 5+ years Location: Pune**
---------------------------------------

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced **System Administrator** 5+ years of experience in system administration, network management, and IT infrastructure support. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing servers, desktops, LAN/WAN and wireless networks, ensuring IT security, and providing technical support to users. The candidate should possess strong expertise in **Windows Server, Active Directory, Office 365, Azure, IAM services, virtualization, and network administration** Experience in **ISMS and ISO audits** will be an added advantage

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handle daily technical support activities on desktop support, data network and server management.
* Installing and configuring new hardware and software.
* Setup desktop computers and peripherals and test network connections.
* Interact with staff on desktop problems and their resolution.
* Responsibility for security over the internet, LAN etc.
* Applying operating system updates, patches, and configuration changes.
* Troubleshooting experience in the corporate environment
* Design and deploy organization LANs, WANs, and wireless networks, including servers, routers, hubs, switches, UPSs, and other hardware.
* Design, setup and configure complex switching environments.
* Configuring and installing client and server network software for upgrading and maintaining network and telecommunication systems.
* Maintain inventory like Software, Hardware etc.
* Maintain & Manage Office 365 / Windows Azure and IAM services to ensure immediate remediation of the reported issues and achieve required.
* ISMS And ISO audits.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, System Administration, or a closely related field, or equivalent experience required.
* 4-8 years of experience in System administration, Network administration.
* System administration and IT certifications in Linux, Microsoft, or other network related fields are a plus.
* Working knowledge of virtualization, Hyper-V, and Windows Failover Clustering.
* Knowledge on Active Directory services and Office 365 Email server.
* Exposure in mail infrastructure especially MS Office Outlook Administration 2010/2013/2016.
* Experience in Windows server 2008R2/2012R2/2016 and administration.
* Experience in MS Windows server 2016/2019 and administration.
* knowledge in Endpoint Protection Security Products like Trend Micro Enterprise.
* Experience of attending ISMS And ISO audits.
